summary: Frontend sign-in screen loads responsively and unauthenticated API protection responds, but authenticated end-to-end coverage was blocked because setup is already consumed with undocumented credentials. The reusable pytest suite contains 4 tests, all skipped for that reason.

critical.issue: First-run setup is already completed, but /app/memory/test_credentials.md contains no credentials; required setup/login and all protected API flows cannot be verified in this environment.

minor.issue: Backend accepts passwords shorter than 8 characters (minimum is enforced only by the browser); duplicate user email can surface a database exception instead of a meaningful 409 response.

integration_issues.issue: Could not execute because the deployed data has an existing admin whose credentials are not documented; attempted temporary test credentials return 401.

action_items: Provide valid temporary admin credentials or reset the preview database so first-run setup can be tested.
Enforce password minimum length with Pydantic on setup/user creation and return 409 for duplicate emails.
Re-run authenticated Playwright and API CRUD/operator/report tests after credentials are available.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses allow_origin_regex=".*" with allow_credentials=True; restrict origins to configured frontend origin before production.
The advertised external CCTV status API is not wired; refresh performs TCP port 80 reachability only.
All seeded CCTV addresses appear private/unreachable from the deployment, so refresh will likely mark them offline; confirm intended network placement.
seed_data_creation: No test seed created; setup was already complete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL is https://infra-watch-8.preview.emergentagent.com. setup/status currently returns needs_setup=false. test_credentials.md is empty. Sign-in screen renders at desktop/mobile-sized viewport; attempted test-admin-noc@example.com credentials return 401.
rca of the issue: The test fixture correctly skips when setup is already complete and the known temporary admin credentials do not authenticate. This avoids inventing credentials, but leaves all protected flows unverified until the preview database is reset or credentials are supplied.
